lines.zh: 我的嘴太重，走起来往前栽。
lines.en: My mouth is too heavy, so I pitch forward as I walk.

lines.zh: 每一步都张一次嘴，我控制不住。
lines.en: My mouth opens with every step, and I cannot stop it.

lines.zh: 我在深层的地上挪，肚子擦着石头。
lines.en: I drag across the Deep's floor, belly scraping stone.

lines.zh: 这条腿短，那条更短，所以走得歪。
lines.en: One leg is short, the other shorter, so I walk crooked.

lines.zh: 我走三步就要合一次嘴，很累。
lines.en: Every three steps I must close my mouth, which tires me.

lines.zh: 地上没有草，我的脚印是牙印。
lines.en: There is no grass here; my footprints are tooth marks.

lines.zh: 我往前扑着走，像随时要咬。
lines.en: I lunge as I walk, as if always about to bite.

lines.zh: 石缝里的风带着铁味，我顺着走。
lines.en: Wind from the seams smells of iron, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我的影子被嘴分成两半。
lines.en: My shadow is split in two by my own mouth.

lines.zh: 走慢一点，嘴里就不会灌土。
lines.en: Walking slower keeps the dirt out of my mouth.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙走，墙那边有声音。
lines.en: I walk along the wall; there is noise beyond it.

lines.zh: 走得太急，我咬到了自己的舌头。
lines.en: Walking too fast, I bite my own tongue.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴站着，等东西自己进来。
lines.en: I stand with my mouth open, waiting for things to enter.

lines.zh: 合上嘴，世界一下就安静了。
lines.en: When I close my mouth, the world goes quiet at once.

lines.zh: 我在舔牙缝里剩下的东西。
lines.en: I am licking what is left between my teeth.

lines.zh: 这层石头很冷，贴着牙根发酸。
lines.en: This stone is cold, and it aches against my gums.

lines.zh: 我数不清自己有多少颗牙。
lines.en: I cannot count how many teeth I have.

lines.zh: 嘴张太久，两边的肉会抖。
lines.en: Held open too long, the flesh at my jaw trembles.

lines.zh: 我听见滴水，一滴一滴，很慢。
lines.en: I hear dripping, one drop at a time, very slow.

lines.zh: 这里没有人，我把嘴闭上了一会儿。
lines.en: No one is here, so I closed my mouth a while.

lines.zh: 我肚子响，声音从嘴里传出来。
lines.en: My stomach growls, and the sound comes out of my mouth.

lines.zh: 我缩进墙角，嘴还是露在外面。
lines.en: I fold into the corner, but my mouth still shows.

lines.zh: 你太小，我一时找不到从哪下嘴。
lines.en: You are small; I cannot decide where to start.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张到最大，让你看看里面。
lines.en: I open my mouth as wide as it goes to show you inside.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西会反光，很碍眼。
lines.en: The thing in your hand glares, and it bothers me.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的喉咙，那里最软。
lines.en: I stare at your throat; that is the softest part.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我的嘴跟着转。
lines.en: As you back away, my mouth turns to follow.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，我闻到你怕了。
lines.en: Standing there, you smell of fear to me.

lines.zh: 你的护甲很硬，你的脸不硬。
lines.en: Your armor is hard; your face is not.

lines.zh: 我张嘴时你抖了一下，我看见了。
lines.en: You flinched when I opened my mouth, and I saw.

lines.zh: 你说话的声音，让我的牙发痒。
lines.en: The sound of your voice makes my teeth itch.

lines.zh: 别低头看我，我会以为你要咬。
lines.en: Do not lower your head at me; I will think you mean to bite.

lines.zh: 你砍进我的嘴，我合不上了。
lines.en: You cut into my mouth, and now it will not close.

lines.zh: 疼的时候我咬得更紧，改不了。
lines.en: In pain I bite harder; I cannot help it.

lines.zh: 我的血是冷的，流得很慢。
lines.en: My blood is cold and flows slowly.

lines.zh: 你砍断一颗牙，它还在你靴子上。
lines.en: You broke a tooth, and it is still on your boot.

lines.zh: 这一下让我软了半边脸。
lines.en: The blow slackened half of my face.

lines.zh: 我不退，我只会往前咬。
lines.en: I do not retreat; I only bite forward.

lines.zh: 嘴里全是自己的血，很腥。
lines.en: My mouth is full of my own blood, and it is rank.

lines.zh: 你打中我的下巴，嘴歪了。
lines.en: You hit my jaw, and my mouth hangs crooked.

lines.zh: 四十五点血，你还得砍很多刀。
lines.en: Forty-five points; you have many cuts to go.

lines.zh: 你伤我，我记住你咬起来的味。
lines.en: Wound me and I will remember how you taste.

lines.zh: 你扔过来的东西，我不认识。
lines.en: I do not recognize what you threw over.

lines.zh: 食物？我嘴里已经有石头了。
lines.en: Food? I already have stones in my mouth.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我张大了嘴。
lines.en: You reach out, and my mouth opens wider.

lines.zh: 我不吃别人递的，我自己咬。
lines.en: I do not eat what is handed to me; I bite for it.

lines.zh: 那块肉太小，塞不住我的牙缝。
lines.en: That meat is too small to fill a gap in my teeth.

lines.zh: 你以为喂饱我就不咬你。
lines.en: You think feeding me will keep me from biting.

lines.zh: 我闻到味道了，可我不信你的手。
lines.en: I smell it, but I do not trust your hand.

lines.zh: 退后，你丢的东西我也咬了。
lines.en: Stand back; I bit what you dropped as well.

lines.zh: 我这辈子没被喂过。
lines.en: In my whole life no one has fed me.

lines.zh: 你留着吧，我等大的。
lines.en: Keep it; I am waiting for something bigger.

lines.zh: 你撞在我嘴上，牙磕到了你。
lines.en: You hit my mouth, and my teeth caught you.

lines.zh: 张着嘴被撞，我差点咬掉舌头。
lines.en: Bumped with my mouth open, I nearly bit off my tongue.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我合了嘴，很响。
lines.en: That knock snapped my mouth shut, loudly.

lines.zh: 你的重量推得我往后滑了一截。
lines.en: Your weight shoves me back a stretch.

lines.zh: 我的牙在你袖子上留了两个洞。
lines.en: My teeth left two holes in your sleeve.

lines.zh: 别贴着我的脸，我会本能地咬。
lines.en: Do not press against my face; I bite by instinct.

lines.zh: 撞完，我嘴里多了点铁味。
lines.en: After the collision there is a taste of iron in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我太轻，被你撞得转了半圈。
lines.en: I am too light; the blow spins me half around.

lines.zh: 退开，嘴里的石头要咽下去了。
lines.en: Back off; the stone in my mouth is going down.

lines.zh: 撞我没好处，我连骨头都不掉。
lines.en: There is no profit in hitting me; I do not even drop bone.

lines.zh: 两张嘴对着张开，就算是求偶。
lines.en: Two mouths open at each other, and that is courtship.

lines.zh: 她的牙比我密，我数不过来。
lines.en: Her teeth are denser than mine, and I cannot count them.

lines.zh: 我们不碰嘴，碰了就会咬。
lines.en: We do not touch mouths; touching means biting.

lines.zh: 我把咬到的最硬那块推给她。
lines.en: I push the hardest piece I bit to her.

lines.zh: 并排走着，两张嘴一起张合。
lines.en: Walking side by side, two mouths open and close together.

lines.zh: 小的生下来就有牙，先咬的是我。
lines.en: The young are born with teeth and bite me first.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一块石头对看。
lines.en: We look at each other across a stone.

lines.zh: 她叫起来像石头磨石头。
lines.en: Her call sounds like stone grinding stone.

lines.zh: 一起待着，谁也不闭嘴。
lines.en: Staying together, neither of us closes its mouth.

lines.zh: 分开时她咬我一口，算道别。
lines.en: When we part she bites me once, as farewell.

lines.zh: 我咬起来，含在嘴里带走。
lines.en: I bite it up and carry it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 嘴里东西太多，我说话都漏风。
lines.en: My mouth is so full that air leaks when I speak.

lines.zh: 这块骨头我咬不动，但要留着。
lines.en: I cannot crack this bone, but I will keep it.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我先舔一下再决定。
lines.en: What you drop, I lick first and decide after.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能整张脸去凑。
lines.en: I have no hands; I must bring my whole face.

lines.zh: 含太久，我的牙会发麻。
lines.en: Held too long, my teeth go numb.

lines.zh: 这颗石子很圆，适合垫在舌下。
lines.en: This pebble is round and fits under my tongue.

lines.zh: 我不敢张嘴捡，怕一开就咬。
lines.en: I dare not open up to pick; I fear I will bite.

lines.zh: 你的鞋带，我咬下来收着了。
lines.en: I bit off your shoelace and kept it.

lines.zh: 太重，我只咬下一小块。
lines.en: Too heavy; I only bit off a small piece.

lines.zh: 你走进这条通道，我的嘴就张开了。
lines.en: You enter this passage, and my mouth opens.

lines.zh: 我闻到血了，不是我的。
lines.en: I smell blood, and it is not mine.

lines.zh: 这里就我们两个，很好。
lines.en: There are only the two of us here, which is good.

lines.zh: 你踩到的东西，是我的晚饭。
lines.en: What you stepped on was my dinner.

lines.zh: 我的嘴比你的头大，你想想。
lines.en: My mouth is wider than your head; think about that.

lines.zh: 你回头两次，我不在同一个地方。
lines.en: You looked back twice, and I had moved each time.

lines.zh: 你砍两刀砍不倒我，我一口就够。
lines.en: Two cuts will not fell me; one bite of mine is enough.

lines.zh: 脚步声在这层石头里传得很远。
lines.en: Footsteps carry far in this layer of stone.

lines.zh: 我不追快的，我追累的。
lines.en: I do not chase the fast; I chase the tired.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味让我牙根发酸。
lines.en: The iron smell on you sets my gums aching.

lines.zh: 张嘴太久，口水滴到了石头上。
lines.en: My mouth open so long, drool drips onto the stone.

lines.zh: 这条路的尽头是我，不是出口。
lines.en: The end of this path is me, not an exit.

lines.zh: 你一停，我就当你不走了。
lines.en: The moment you stop, I take it you are staying.

lines.zh: 今天我不挑食。
lines.en: Tonight I am not a picky eater.

lines.zh: 石头缝里能听见你的脚步。
lines.en: Your steps carry through the cracks.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴等，你总会过来。
lines.en: I wait open-mouthed; you will come this way.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面爬，嘴一直朝你。
lines.en: I crawl low with my mouth always toward you.

lines.zh: 你退，我就把嘴张大一点。
lines.en: The more you retreat, the wider I open.

lines.zh: 我等你的刀先挥空。
lines.en: I wait for your blade to swing and miss.

lines.zh: 我在数你退了几步，三步了。
lines.en: I count your retreating steps: three now.

lines.zh: 我的牙在响，那不是叫声。
lines.en: My teeth are clicking, and that is not a call.

lines.zh: 你听不见我，因为我没在走。
lines.en: You cannot hear me because I am not walking.

lines.zh: 你举火把的手在抖，影子也在抖。
lines.en: Your torch hand shakes, and so does its shadow.

lines.zh: 从这边绕，你背后是墙。
lines.en: Go around this way and your back meets the wall.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊了你会跑。
lines.en: I stay quiet; noise would make you run.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道越来越近。
lines.en: Your smell grows nearer with every breath.

lines.zh: 我嘴合上了，那是要动的前兆。
lines.en: My mouth has closed, which comes before a lunge.

lines.zh: 别往上看，上面没有路。
lines.en: Do not look up; there is no way up.

lines.zh: 你退了九步，后面是死路。
lines.en: Nine steps back, and the path ends.

lines.zh: 我等你把背靠到石头上。
lines.en: I wait for your back to reach the stone.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁，把你往凹处逼。
lines.en: I hug the stone and herd you into the hollow.

lines.zh: 我闻到你手心的汗。
lines.en: I smell the sweat on your palms.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我的嘴合一次。
lines.en: Each step of yours, my mouth shuts once.

lines.zh: 路的另一头，我留了一张嘴。
lines.en: I left a mouth at the other end of the path.

lines.zh: 我不动，动的是我的影子。
lines.en: I stay still; only my shadow moves.

lines.zh: 你数岔道的工夫，我又近了。
lines.en: While you count the side paths, I close in.

lines.zh: 我整张脸扑上去，先咬住再说。
lines.en: I throw my whole face at you and bite first.

lines.zh: 这一口八点，够你退半边身子。
lines.en: Eight points, enough to turn you half around.

lines.zh: 我的牙不尖，但咬合力很大。
lines.en: My teeth are not sharp, but my jaw is strong.

lines.zh: 咬住就不松，除非你把我甩开。
lines.en: Once I bite, I hold until you throw me off.

lines.zh: 我咬你的小腿，那里够得着。
lines.en: I bite your shin, since it is within reach.

lines.zh: 你打在嘴上，我的牙断了一颗。
lines.en: You strike my mouth and one tooth breaks.

lines.zh: 我扑空了，嘴撞在石头上。
lines.en: I miss and my mouth slams into stone.

lines.zh: 这一下连着甲一起咬进去了。
lines.en: This bite went through the armor with the flesh.

lines.zh: 我咬完往后退，等第二口。
lines.en: After biting I pull back for a second bite.

lines.zh: 你不叫，我就咬得更用力。
lines.en: You do not cry out, so I bite harder.

lines.zh: 我把你往墙边推，用嘴拱。
lines.en: I push you toward the wall, shoving with my mouth.

lines.zh: 嘴里有你的一块，我先咽了。
lines.en: A piece of you is in my mouth, and I swallow.

lines.zh: 我咬到了自己的唇，很疼。
lines.en: I bit my own lip, and it hurts.

lines.zh: 这一口是试味道，下一口不是。
lines.en: This bite was to taste; the next will not be.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的护腕，连胳膊一起甩。
lines.en: I bite your bracer and swing the whole arm.

lines.zh: 这一口落空，牙磕出火星。
lines.en: I miss, and my teeth strike sparks.

lines.zh: 我把你往后颈一压，人就矮了半截。
lines.en: I bear down on your neck and you drop a head's height.

lines.zh: 我咬的地方，甲都翻起来了。
lines.en: Where I bit, the plating curls up.

lines.zh: 你甩开我，嘴里还咬着布片。
lines.en: You throw me off with cloth still in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我合嘴太快，咬到了自己的舌。
lines.en: I snap too fast and bite my own tongue.

lines.zh: 深层的地面裂开，我的嘴先出来。
lines.en: The Deep's floor splits, and my mouth comes out first.

lines.zh: 我从一条缝里挤出来，牙磕着石头。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a seam, teeth knocking stone.

lines.zh: 先是气味，然后是我这张嘴。
lines.en: First the smell, then this mouth of mine.

lines.zh: 深层的地缝把我吐出来，我张嘴就咬。
lines.en: The deep seams spat me out, and I bite at once.

lines.zh: 石头下埋了很多东西，我咬开一层。
lines.en: Much is buried under the stone; I bit through one layer.

lines.zh: 我出生时嘴里含着别人的骨头。
lines.en: I was born with another creature's bone in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我从墙里出来，抖掉一身石屑。
lines.en: I come out of the wall and shake off the grit.

lines.zh: 光很暗，正合我的眼。
lines.en: The light is dim, which suits my eyes.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，发现合不上。
lines.en: I opened my mouth and found I could not close it.

lines.zh: 有人在附近，我先藏起半个身子。
lines.en: Someone is near, so I hide half of myself.

lines.zh: 空气里有铁，我把嘴张大了。
lines.en: There is iron in the air, and I open wide.

lines.zh: 我的第一声不是叫，是咬牙。
lines.en: My first sound was not a cry but a gnash.

lines.zh: 火进了嘴，我合上也没用。
lines.en: Fire got into my mouth, and closing it did not help.

lines.zh: 我嘴先着地，牙全磕在石上。
lines.en: I land mouth first, teeth cracking on the stone.

lines.zh: 水灌进这张嘴，我吞了半肚子。
lines.en: Water pours into this mouth and I swallow half a belly.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的嘴撑得更开。
lines.en: The blast forces my mouth even wider.

lines.zh: 箭从嘴里进去，从颈后出来。
lines.en: The arrow enters my mouth and exits behind my neck.

lines.zh: 药水在我嘴里起泡，很难受。
lines.en: The potion foams in my mouth, and it is awful.

lines.zh: 我连石头都咬，咬得牙发麻。
lines.en: I bite even stones until my teeth go numb.

lines.zh: 雷落在我张开的嘴上，亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my open mouth and lights it once.

lines.zh: 嘴里什么都没有，连声音也没有。
lines.en: There is nothing in my mouth, not even sound.
